text: City of Newark City Clerk’s Office 37101 Newark Boulevard Newark, CA 94560 NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a General Municipal Election will be held in the City of Newark on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, for the following offices: • Mayor — Full term of two years • Two Members of the City Council — Full term of four years The nomination period for these offices begins on July 13, 2026, and closes on August 7, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. Nomination forms may be obtained from the Office of the City Clerk. (Election Code §10220) If nomination papers for an incumbent officer are not filed by August 7, 2026, the nomination period for that office shall be extended until August 12, 2026, at 5:00 p.m., for candidates other than the incumbent(s). (Election Code §10225) If no one or only one person is nominated for an elective office, appointment to the office may be made as prescribed by California Elections Code §10229. The polls will be open on November 3, 2026, from 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. (Election Code §§1000, 14212) Neetu Salwan, CMC City Clerk Publication Date: July 7, 2026 – Tri City Voice 510.578.4266 I city.clerk@newarkca.gov I 37101 Newark Boulevard, Newark, CA 94560 I www.newarkca.gov
